message: Matched feature controls complete. Judge real-minus-shuffled paired effects; no test-based selection.

matched_summary.interpretation: Pre-2019 exploratory contrasts on a fixed source-only college baseline. Whole-family row shuffles retain within-family structure and exact masks; immovable strata limit the contrast. Conditional RR-RP/PR comparisons are matched in shape. Repeated RR/seed/fold contrasts are not independent datasets. No clean test claim, significance test, or automatic promotion.
